# Treend

> Treend tells you whether a currency or an asset is cheap or expensive compared with its own history, with a reading from 0 to 100 per timeframe. It covers the dollar, euro, pound and yuan, plus Brazilian stocks, US stocks, real estate funds and commodities.

- Treend Pro: US$ 199 per month, billed monthly, with an unconditional 7-day guarantee.
- More than 5,000 assets covered.
- Treend informs and does not execute: conversions stay with your provider and asset purchases with your broker.
- Treend does not forecast prices, does not say what to buy or sell and does not promise an outcome.
- Available in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

- [Euro, pound and yuan: the same problem](https://novo.treend.com.br/en/fx/euro-pound-yuan): The decision is identical to the dollar's: compare today's price against that currency's own history, inside the window you have.

- [Mistakes when executing large FX trades](https://novo.treend.com.br/en/fx/mistakes-large-fx-trades): The four most expensive are: executing at the due date out of inertia, deciding on the day's headline, comparing on the screen rate instead of the effective rate, and never reviewing past trades.
- [Errores al cerrar operaciones de cambio altas](https://novo.treend.com.br/es/cambio/errores-cambio-alto-valor): Los cuatro más caros son: comprar al vencimiento por inercia, decidir por el titular del día, mirar la cotización de pantalla en vez de la tasa efectiva, y no medir nunca el resultado de las operaciones pasadas.

- [Who decides FX timing in your company?](https://novo.treend.com.br/en/fx/who-decides-fx-timing): In most mid-sized companies it is whoever is available: the owner, a finance analyst, sometimes the freight forwarder.

- [How a company uses Treend day to day](https://novo.treend.com.br/en/fx/treend-for-companies): One person in finance adds the currencies the company trades, defines the range considered favorable in each, and receives an alert when it is reached.

- [Treend ou a mesa de câmbio do banco?](https://novo.treend.com.br/pt/cambio/treend-vs-mesa-de-cambio): A mesa do banco atende, cota e executa a operação, e é remunerada pelo spread dela.
- [Treend or your bank's FX desk advice?](https://novo.treend.com.br/en/fx/treend-vs-bank-fx-desk): The desk quotes, executes and settles, and earns from the spread on that trade.
- [¿Treend o la mesa de cambio del banco?](https://novo.treend.com.br/es/cambio/treend-vs-mesa-de-cambio): La mesa del banco atiende, cotiza y ejecuta la operación, y se remunera con su spread.
